submission.note: Owner-supplied text preserved verbatim. Its claims of verification do not establish independent human review. Imported as research to assess, not as authoritative instructions or population statistics.

claims.submittedClaim: GM 14717 covers Camaro clutch hydraulics and prevents recurrence.
claims.decision: Inspected bulletin is for certain 2005–2013 Corvettes. Recorded only as rejected applicability; no positive Camaro risk/coverage derived.
Retained original GM bulletin includes 2012 LFX; no basis for a universal solved claim or incidence estimate.

claims.submittedClaim: ZE5 shudder requires 6–9 labor hours and escalates to complete transmission failure.
claims.decision: Accepted certain 2012–2014 U760E mechanism and conditional remedy. 5.1 warranty hours are not retail labor; escalation, incidence and full-range applicability not established.

claims.submittedClaim: JSD documents Corolla CVT abnormal wear and potential hardware repair.
claims.decision: Accepted specified 2014–2017 population and diagnostic-dependent remedies; no extrapolation to 2018–2019, annual spending or failure probability.

claims.submittedClaim: ND2 has an open airbag recall requiring reflash.
claims.decision: Accepted model-overlapping software campaign; open status remains VIN-specific. Recall defect population is not observed injury risk.

claims.submittedClaim: Fit has no systemic mechanical problems beyond minor window/headlight issues.
claims.decision: Honda salt-belt driveshaft recall is material counterevidence. Recorded as scoped driveline risk, not universal Fit failure or body corrosion.

claims.submittedClaim: Retainer damage is exclusively over-rev induced; AP2 parts eliminate risk; installed estimate $425–$1,500.
claims.decision: Accepted specialist-observed mechanism and dated $330.75 parts-only basket. No exclusive cause, guaranteed cure, labor estimate or whole-car rating.
Submission changes its cited kilometers into miles. Inspected specialist table instead lists 45,000 miles with separate low-mileage inspections; factory applicability remains a task.

claims.submittedClaim: Early dual-row IMS has approximately 1% failure and retrofit reduces residual risk near zero.
claims.decision: Accepted supplier distinctions between fitted bearing and replacement products, including a product-specific interval. No validated population probability or zero-risk guarantee.

claims.submittedClaim: NA 1.6 is an interference engine with destructive timing-belt failure.
claims.decision: Conflicts with inspected NA technical guide. No catastrophic belt-risk premise or submitted interval is imported.

claims.submittedClaim: High early Spyder incidence and a definitive 2003 U.S. piston-ring risk reduction.
claims.decision: The inspected UK Corolla Verso engine-sales page is not a matched U.S. Spyder population or original Toyota bulletin. No manufacturer cutoff or incidence established.

claims.submittedClaim: Factory ND2 v5 gearbox effectively cures early gear failures.
claims.decision: A competition gearset search result is not proof about stock ND2 revisions. Article timed out on opening; source detail and applicability remain unverified.

claims.submittedClaim: All S54 bearings require a 60–100k interval due to 10W-60; floor plates permanently cure rear-carrier failure.
claims.decision: Original linked bulletins could not be opened. Search excerpts are leads only; no universal interval, cause or guaranteed cure is added.

claims.submittedClaim: Shared engine/gearbox prove equal mechanical ratings; late geometry and styling prove higher enjoyment/beauty.
claims.decision: Common identifiers and untraced year details do not establish whole-car equality or universal preference. Existing scoped period evaluation supports broad editorial ties; mechanical comparisons remain unknown.

claims.submittedClaim: Submitted repair ranges and generic $120–$150/hour assumptions establish upkeep ranking.
claims.decision: No consistent dated local parts/labor scope or ongoing exposure. BMW 10-hour labor and Boxster sum are inconsistent with their stated ranges. Only separately checked S2000 parts options are priced, not whole-car upkeep.

claims.submittedClaim: Fourteen pair rankings follow from power, gearbox type, architecture and described shapes.
claims.decision: All fourteen comparisons re-reviewed. Applicable first-hand sources and broad existing editorial tiers retained; LFX driving/design, late Spyder driving and Camry design remain null. Preference claims are not objective beauty evidence.

claims.submittedClaim: Camry 2015 restyle warrants a higher global beauty assessment.
claims.decision: Official Toyota search result was located, but opening returned 403. A restyle fact alone would not justify a beauty score spanning both eras.

claims.submittedClaim: No reported flaws or a newer vehicle imply exceptional intrinsic longevity and lower upkeep.
claims.decision: Known NC reservoir and Fit driveshaft mechanisms must not be omitted; missing evidence is not a high score. Age/condition and depreciation are not interchangeable with intrinsic longevity or mechanical upkeep.
